evidence.quote: If you do not enable full supplemental logging for a table, then Oracle does not record the values for columns that are not changed"; reporter: "I set up supplemental logging.. but, during test, I re-create whole db and forgot it

notes: Missing key columns in update events came from table-level supplemental logging not being set. The 'AA==' ID was the documented NUMBER(38) Decimal encoding. Debezium emits what LogMiner provides and warns about missing supplemental logging.
